capabilities: Record an append-only audit.v1 receipt for every agent inference
Ingest receipts from an OM-1 audit inbox file with deduplication
Verify ledger integrity by detecting malformed blocks, duplicates, and sequence gaps
Write a rolling digest with counts, statuses, tokens, and durations
Install vault-scoped audit hooks for local agents like Claude Code
disambiguation: Not a forensic or tamper-proof audit system; the README calls it a journal of your own agents with no crypto and no tamper-evidence.
extras: Not distributed via the Obsidian community directory; BRAT can track the repo for updates. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. The receipt writer ships only with source installs, not plugin releases. Detailed specs live in separate SPEC.md and INTEGRATION.md files.
problem: AI agents acting in a vault leave no trace of what they did, when, or with which model, so there is no way to review or verify their activity.

relations.evidence: Speaks OM-1 (Obsidian Messenger): agents, other plugins, or a shell one-liner can all file receipts
Install agent audit hooks writes vault-scoped configs (Claude Code, OpenCode) so local agents file their own receipts
See INTEGRATION.md for wiring up curtis-ai-chat.

requires.name: local AI agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini CLI)

summary: Local-first audit trail that logs each AI agent action as an append-only markdown receipt in per-day ledger files in your vault.
